summary: Sullivans Cove is an award-winning Tasmanian single cask whisky distillery in Cambridge (est. 1994) with a small finance team: CFO Simon Loader and Finance Manager Nainika Mascarenhas. It runs Xero, Employment Hero and Shopify, operates a cellar door, and received a federal grant to build a new waterfront distillery. Drafts go to Nainika, who runs the day-to-day books.

hooks.text: Small finance team running Xero plus Shopify plus a cellar door: bank, payout and card reconciliations land on Nainika.
New grant-funded waterfront distillery and tourism site adds capex tracking and a second revenue stream to the close.
Admin staff currently handle Xero AR/AP, so automating matching frees a thin team.

risks.text: Specialist excise and bonded-inventory accounting limits what a reconciliation tool covers; very small team may lack budget.
Grant term ended Aug 2025 and the new-site timing is unconfirmed; the site move may not be current news.

No 2026 news found on the new site's progress.
